name: Feedback email alerts over SMTP
objective: When the worker persists a captured feedback event, send one plain-text email alert via SMTP to the account email of the owning org's owner (feedback -> project -> tenant -> owner member). SMTP transport is configured entirely from env (VOCKY_SMTP_*), reusing the SMTP account changple5 already uses in production; unconfigured SMTP means alerts are cleanly disabled, and a send failure is never allowed to duplicate or requeue an already-persisted feedback event. Recipient/preferences configurability is deliberately out of scope — this phase lands the default-on, owner-addressed alert only.

review.note: All validation green (225 tests, three compose guards); containment invariant and multi-tenant recipient join verified structurally; live alert confirmed by the operator; five doc versions consolidated (backend, architecture, operations, security, qa).
